1.title: CNG-EPT
1.description: Centralized platform for Guinea's educational indicators.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Every initiative begins with an observation. For CNG/EPT, the main challenge is to provide Guinean citizens with reliable access to clear, up-to-date, and actionable educational data — across the entire national territory — to support decisions, policies, and advocacy. This involves gathering diverse indicators (student enrollment, budgets, girls' education, equity, etc.) from various sources, while ensuring transparency, consistency, and accessibility for all.

solution.title: The Solution
solution.content: To address these needs, CNG/EPT adopts a "data & user-oriented" approach:
points: The platform serves as a centralized hub for Guinea's educational indicators — budget, attendance, equity, regional distributions, educational resources, etc.

Thanks to clear navigation (tabs for "Data", "Schools", "Resources", "Reports/Studies/Educational Materials/Educational Policies"), users can easily explore, filter, or search for the information they need.
The organization's structure — 27 member organizations covering the education sector — enables pooling efforts, harmonizing data, and ensuring participatory and inclusive governance.

By combining the strength of civil society, institutional partnerships, and support from donors/international partners, CNG/EPT establishes a monitoring and evaluation system that enables budget tracking, regional analysis, transparency, and advocacy.

2.title: Ibarry Marketing
2.description: Digital marketing agency combining creativity, strategy, and multicultural adaptability.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Every business starts with an idea — and often, a need for visibility, credibility, and growth. For iBarry Marketing, the initial challenge was to give small and medium-sized businesses, wherever they are, the means to transform themselves into a strong, credible, and memorable brand. Many businesses have a good product or service, but lack strategy, design, or visual identity to convince their customers. The goal was therefore to build an agency capable of supporting diverse companies — startups, local businesses in Africa or elsewhere, or diasporic businesses — and help them stand out in a competitive digital space, while valuing their history, culture, and ambitions.

solution.title: The Solution
solution.content: iBarry Marketing addresses this need by combining creativity, digital strategy, and multicultural adaptability.
points: The agency offers a complete visual identity (branding, design) designed to define who you are and what you represent.
Design of elegant, high-performing websites and mobile applications adapted to modern usage, enabling conversion of visitors into customers.
Implementation of customized marketing strategies — based on data, culture, target audience — to maximize visibility, attract prospects, and strengthen trust.
A personalized approach: each project is designed according to the specific needs of the business — no "one-size-fits-all" solution.
A multicultural team — strategists, designers, developers from diverse backgrounds — which enables combining a global perspective with local market understanding.

3.title: TLC (Teckland)
3.description: Mobile carpooling and ride-matching application for flexible mobility.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Every urban trip — and every move — often begins with a challenge: finding a reliable, affordable, and accessible means of transportation, especially in contexts where public transport is limited or impractical. For TLC (Teckland), the challenge is to offer a flexible mobility solution that allows individuals to move around easily, without depending on traditional transport, while optimizing available resources (cars, drivers, routes). The goal is to build a platform capable of connecting drivers and passengers in a simple and secure way, managing traffic uncertainties, availability, and constraints of distance, cost, and comfort — while remaining efficient, scalable, and accessible to as many users as possible.

solution.title: The Solution
solution.content: TLC (Teckland) addresses this need by offering a mobile carpooling / ride-matching application, designed for simplicity, speed, and flexibility:
points: The application allows a user to request a ride or offer a ride if they are driving, thus facilitating carpooling as needed.
Intuitive mobile interface, designed for user comfort — whether passenger or driver — to search, offer, or accept a ride easily.
Route-user matching system: the app connects passengers and drivers going in the same direction, which helps reduce costs and optimize vehicle occupancy.
Ability to make secure payments (if applicable) — or clear cost sharing — so the service remains transparent and reliable.
Useful features such as estimated time of arrival (ETA), route tracking, driver / passenger contact, and facilitation of logistics before/after the trip.
